changelog:
- Added scene restoration (save/restore light states)
- Implemented brightness boost and color saturation adjustments
- Added blackout threshold (skip sync on black screens)
- Implemented color change detection for performance
- Added network retry logic with exponential backoff
- Migrated to IHttpClientFactory for better HTTP management
- Added status API endpoint
- Enhanced configuration UI with advanced settings
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
